findings.quote: Writing the speed below A as v₂² = u² − 2gh instead of u² + 2gh for downward displacement gives u² + 2gh = 4(u² − 2gh) misapplied, leading to a height other than 5h/3.
findings.note: The equation quoted as the consequence of the error, u² + 2gh = 4(u² − 2gh), is the CORRECT relation already written in step 3; showing it as the product of a mistake could lead a student to reject the right line. The stated error actually gives u² − 2gh = 4(u² − 2gh), hence u² = 2gh and H = h.
findings.fix: Writing the speed below A as v₂² = u² − 2gh instead of u² + 2gh gives u² − 2gh = 4(u² − 2gh), so u² = 2gh and a maximum height of h instead of 5h/3.
